name: Main Hall (Northshire)
summary: Newcomers report to the Main Hall at Northshire Abbey in western Elwynn. From there, they reach the Hall of Arms, the Library Wing, and the abbey tower before receiving their first assignments defending Stormwind.

sections.title: Heart of the Abbey
sections.body:
Trainees and clerics pass through the Main Hall when they enter Northshire Abbey. The chamber joins the Hall of Arms, where recruits prepare for battle, to the Library Wing and the stairs to the abbey tower.

Strife in the valley reaches even this quiet place. Officers gather able newcomers here to defend the kingdom's borders.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Main Hall?
faq.answer: The Main Hall connects the Hall of Arms, the Library Wing, and the upper tower of Northshire Abbey. Recruits, priests, and visitors pass through this central chamber.
Stormwind defense officers and clerics in the Main Hall assess newcomers and give them their first orders. They are told to clear threats from the abbey grounds.

angles.text: As a human of the kingdom, you begin serving Stormwind and the Holy Light in Northshire Abbey's Main Hall.
